## The Pattern

Describe the structural pattern -- a process convention, session approach, tool integration, or growth observation that improved your PAI.

## Operational Evidence

How many sessions has this pattern been in use? What friction did it resolve or what capability did it enable?

## Generalizability

This pattern should work for any Principal regardless of their domain, vocabulary, or tools. Explain why it is not specific to your tree.

## Proposed Change

If you have a specific change to the seed in mind, describe it. Otherwise, the pattern can be discussed before a PR is drafted.
